summary: American Tower filed a Form 8-K on September 18, 2026, reporting that on September 17, 2026, its Board elected Kristen M. Ludgate as a director and member of the Compensation and Human Capital Committee, effective immediately. Ludgate, former Chief People Officer of HP Inc. from 2021 to 2025, will serve until the 2027 Annual Meeting. No financial terms, advisors, or shareholder approvals are involved. The filing also included an Item 8.01 other-events disclosure and Item 9.01 exhibits. The event is a routine board appointment, not a forced or abrupt CEO/CFO departure; no deal or arb angle arises.
